tenders.title: BIM Electrical Engineer for diverse projects across UK, US, and Gulf regions
tenders.scope_summary: Development and coordination of electrical designs using Building Information Modeling (BIM) for projects in the UK, US, and Gulf regions. Responsibilities include BIM Modeling on Revit, MEP services modeling and coordination, clash detection and resolution using Navisworks Manage, and preparation of LOD 400 shop drawings and LOD 300 tender drawings.
key_points: Hands-on experience in BIM Modelling on Revit software is required.
Proficiency in Revit MEP, AutoCAD, Revit Fabrication, BIM 360, Navisworks is essential.
Clash detection and resolution using Navisworks Manage.
Preparation of LOD 400 shop drawings for construction issue and LOD 300 drawings for tender issue.
Knowledge of Dynamo and Autodesk COBie is an advantage.

tenders.title: MEP Engineer-Design & BIM for projects across various sectors
tenders.scope_summary: Develop MEP design deliverables (concept, schematic, detailed design, tender, GFC) for diverse projects and create MEP BIM models in Autodesk Revit (LOD 200-500). Drive multidisciplinary clash detection and resolution using Navisworks Manage, and implement project BIM Execution Plans.
key_points: Develop MEP design deliverables (concept, schematic, detailed design, tender, and GFC).
Develop MEP BIM models in Autodesk Revit across LOD 200 to LOD 500 for various disciplines.
Drive multidisciplinary clash detection and resolution using Navisworks Manage.
Implement and follow project BIM Execution Plans (BEP), LOD matrices, and in-house BIM standards.
Use collaborative platforms such as BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) for model sharing and issue tracking.
